function.name: create_priority_dispatch
function.description: Log the on-call team's priority request when triage says priority_dispatch, or add details to it. It never refuses an emergency: send what you have now. Only issue_summary is needed; calling it again updates the same request (never a second one). For a verified caller pass customer_id and address_id instead of name, phone and address. Never invent a name, phone, ZIP or address. Returns the callback time policy. It does NOT assign or send a technician.

first_name.description: Caller's first name, if they said it. Omit when customer_id is given. Never guessed.

phone.description: Best callback number if different from caller ID, as the caller said it. Never guessed.

customer_id.description: From lookup_customer, if verified. Name and phone then come from the account.

address_id.description: address_id from lookup_customer when the problem is at an address on file. Then omit address.

address.description: Service address as the caller said it. Omit when address_id is given or when you don't know it; any part may be left out.

zip.description: 5-digit ZIP code of the service address. Only what the caller said or lookup_customer returned; never guessed or taken from an example. Leave it out if unknown.

issue_type.description: Main problem. leak = active water or refrigerant leak.

onset.description: When the problem started, in the caller's words, e.g. 'since last night'.

equipment.description: Equipment involved, if known: type, brand, age.

tried_steps.description: What the caller already tried, e.g. 'thermostat set to heat at 72', 'reset the breaker'. Empty array if nothing.

error_code.description: Error code, blinking light pattern or display message, if any.

pets.description: Pets at the home, e.g. 'one dog, will be crated'.

on_site_contact.description: Only when the caller is calling for someone else (e.g. a parent): the person who will be at the home.

phone.description: On-site contact's phone, if different from the caller's.

relationship.description: Relationship to the caller, e.g. 'caller's mother'.

vulnerable_occupants.description: Vulnerable people in the home. Empty array if none.

indoor_temp_f.description: Indoor temperature in Fahrenheit, if known.

reasons.description: The reasons array from triage_issue, unchanged. Leave it out if you don't have it; the backend fills it in.
